text_block_list.text:
One day while on the move.
I heard cheers that sounded like a concert.
Curious, I went to take a peek—

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Ooooo... Fight♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Everyooone~~, thanks for listeningã¼ã¼â¡â¡â¡

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaa!!!!

At the focus of the gathered Umamusume's gazes,
for some reason, was Vivlos, mingling amongst the upperclassmen.

I hadn't heard about any plans for a concert,
so I wonder what the circumstances could be...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-chan, that live was so much fun~! Your singing is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay♡
That might just give me the boost to try even harder♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, come cheer for me at my races, okay?
During the Winning Live, I'll find you right from center stage!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-chan as center...! I'm... I'm defiiinitely going~~~~♡♡

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos, not bad!
Your dancing's gotten crazy good!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really!?
Getting praised by you makes me so happy, Senpai♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'll practice and get even better next time♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Fuha! Sounds good.
Guess I'll just have to come watch you again!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yay, thank youâ¡ I love you, Senpaiâ¡

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Vivlos-chan!
You're overflowing with the charm that every idol needs...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Her fan service, targeting people one by one, is amazing too!
She really does have an incredible natural talent for being an idol—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Trainer-cchi spotted♡
I'm so happy, did you come to watch me?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Falco and the others were
teaching me the mindset of an idol♪
choice_data_list: The secrets of being an idol...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yep! Because idols are just so amazing♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"It's what everyone longs for, so super sparkly!
And that's really important for a celebrity, right?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So they were letting me do it on a trial run♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When you suddenly asked us to teach you,
we were a bit surprised at first, but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've had my eye on her from the start!
I just knew Vivlos-chan had a different kind of idol charm than the rest of us.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To find out, I want to share the same stage...
No, I felt that I HAVE to stand there!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Totally! When we were on the same stage,
I could really feel it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It means returning the love they received from everyone with even biiigger love!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"You two love each other so much, don't you? ♡
That's why everyone's cheering for both of you! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: See? Idols are so super cool, aren't they?♡
(BA-DUUUUM!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-chan...! After just a single stage, she's already grasped the ultimate truth...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The wisdom to find a reason to shine...,
the dexterity to put it into action immediately...
And above all—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"The sheer honesty of conveying love so straightforwardly!
Truly—a natural-born talent for being loved!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, it wasn't just a trial run!
I'm seriously going to be an idol—wait, no!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wanna try being an Umadol... with me?!
choice_data_list: To think she'd be scouted with that much passion...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy, but I'm sorry!
I turn down all scouts like that!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
More importantly...
I'd rather stand by your side as the ultimate celebrity, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Right beside the greatest idols, of course♡

Vivlos's dream is to become a celebrity.
I have to protect that dream...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehe♡ Thank you, both of you!
I'm super happy that you're complimenting me, but—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!
I have a dream I want to achieve with this person, you see♡
